market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile. Oil above $100 and multiyear yield highs create headwinds for equities. CPI print is critical catalyst—hot print triggers further selloff; cool print offers relief. Dow already down 400 points. Expect 5-8% equity volatility over next 2-3 weeks. Energy outperforms; growth lags.

Healthcare tech (continuous monitoring) and AI security offer 12-month structural tailwinds. Trade wars add uncertainty but create domestic supply chain winners.
